connector.name: Émile
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Émile wine cellar - list, add, recommend, scan and search 100k+ wines.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.emile.wine over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sebastiengal account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: EMILE_API_KEY
env.description: API key generated from the Émile iOS app (Profile → Settings → API Keys). Starts with `emile_live_...`.

env.name: EMILE_API_URL
env.description: Optional override for the backend URL — only useful for local development against a self-hosted backend.

env.name: EMILE_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging verbosity. One of: debug, info, warn, error.
